subject.title: feat(slack): allow configurable App Home views

question: Should Slack App Home support file-backed configuration, and if so, should files load only during account startup or explicit reload rather than on every Home-open event?
rationale: The choice establishes durable public configuration, freshness, and availability behavior that cannot be selected safely from implementation mechanics alone.

options.title: Lifecycle-loaded file
options.body: Keep `viewPath`, but resolve and validate it during Slack account startup or an explicit owner reload flow.

options.title: Inline-only view
options.body: Retain `appHome.view` and remove the separate filesystem freshness contract.

options.title: Per-event hot reload
options.body: Keep request-time reads only with explicit acceptance of their latency and transient failure exposure.

recommendation.title: Lifecycle-loaded file
recommendation.body: Keep `viewPath`, but resolve and validate it during Slack account startup or an explicit owner reload flow.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the App Home feature and is the strongest feature-history owner for its customization contract.
